lines: Your hair oil can break out your forehead.
Keep oily hair products off your face.
Three more things your breakouts should never meet.
A sweaty helmet or chin strap. Heat and rubbing can cause acne.
A rough towel after the gym. Pat sweat away, don't rub.
Last night's makeup. Sleeping in it can break you out.
